name: Barbaresco

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

notes: It smells of roses or violets, with cherry, truffle, fennel and licorice, and turns smoky, earthy and leathery with age.
It is very tannic and tight when young and is usually best 5 to 10 years after the vintage.
